method: Manual adversarial construct-level review of the corrected candidate batch against each highest-similarity canonical item after a fresh whole-bank zero-trust pass.

comparisons.reason: Both use inner-mitochondrial-membrane transport, but Q1617 tests SLC25A13/citrin aspartate-glutamate exchange for cytosolic aspartate availability, whereas Q1631 tests SLC25A3 inorganic-phosphate import required as a substrate for ATP synthesis. Transporter, substrate, pathway and phenotype are distinct.

Q1272 tests neuronal KCC2 chloride extrusion and GABA-A signaling. Q1632 tests PNKP DNA-end chemistry with 5-prime kinase and 3-prime phosphatase activities. Shared seizure phenotype is not mechanistic duplication.

Q1617 tests mitochondrial metabolite exchange by citrin. Q1633 tests ATP13A2-mediated lysosomal polyamine, especially spermine, export. Organelle, substrate, transporter family and causal mechanism are distinct.

Q1216 tests COQ8A-related coenzyme-Q biosynthesis and oxidative phosphorylation. Q1634 tests DDHD2 intracellular triglyceride hydrolysis and neuronal lipid-droplet accumulation. The biochemical constructs are distinct.

Q1629 tests LRPPRC-dependent mitochondrial mRNA stabilization and polyadenylation. Q1635 tests MTFMT-dependent formylation of charged mitochondrial Met-tRNA for translation initiation. Both affect mitochondrial gene expression but at different molecular substrates and steps.
